item.title: Not as bad as he first seems
item.content:encoded: As much mundanity as this skip exudes, he ought to act as a sapient Scranton Reality Anchor. ("That's impossible," the Normal Man would deadpan as the most ordinary reslity in the multiverse happened around him — a dull gray bubble of blandness in a rainbow-hued sea of mystery.) Paradoxically, the Foundation would love having this man on their side; he'd suppress any anomalous events long enough to buy them time or help capture difficult reality-benders.
